Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting rejection of all bids except for good cause.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting rejection of all bids except forgood cause; and adding a new section to chapter 39.30 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 39.30 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature recognizes that fair and open competition is abasic tenet of public works procurement. This competition reduces theappearance of and opportunity for favoritism and inspires publicconfidence that contracts are awarded equitably and economically. Thepreservation of the integrity of the competitive bid system dictatesthat after bids for a public work, as defined in RCW 39.04.010, havebeen opened by the state or municipalities, as defined in RCW39.04.010, and institutions of higher education, as defined in RCW28B.10.016, award must be made to the bidder who submitted the lowestresponsive bid, unless there is a cogent and compelling reason toreject all bids and cancel the invitation. (2) Invitations for bids may be canceled after opening the biddingprocess, but prior to award where this action is consistent with p. 1 SB 6669subsection (1) of this section and the public owner determines inwriting that cancellation is in the best interest of the government forspecified reasons such as the following: (a) The invitation for bids included inadequate, ambiguous, orrestrictive specifications. (b) The public work is no longer required. (c) The invitation for bids did not provide for consideration ofall needs of the public owner. (d) All otherwise acceptable bids received are at unreasonableprices. (e) The bids were not independently arrived at in open competition,were collusive, or were submitted in bad faith. (f) The bids received did not provide competition which wasadequate to ensure reasonable prices. (3) The requirements of this section apply to procurement ofsubcontract bid package work under RCW 39.10.061, except that both thepublic owner and the contractor must determine in writing thatrejection of all bids and cancellation of the solicitation of bids isin the best interest of the government for specified reasons.
